rows.note: This is the everyday choice when something needlessly uses or costs money.

example.english: Buying so many useless things is really wasteful.
example.traditional: 你買咁多冇用嘅嘢，真係嘥錢。
example.jyutping: nei5 maai5 gam3 do1 mou5 jung6 ge3 je5 zan1 hai6 saai1 cin2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for wasteful use of money, materials, time, or other resources.

example.english: Leaving the air conditioner on when you're not home is really wasteful.
example.traditional: 你唔喺屋企仲開住冷氣，真係浪費。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hai2 uk1 kei2 zung6 hoi1 zyu6 laang5 hei3 zan1 hai6 long6 fai3
